items.title: Lamar Jackson: Plans to return this season
items.description:
Jackson, who is scheduled to undergo surgery on his injured right thumb, has told teammates he plans to return later this season, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Expected to return Sunday
items.description:
Egbuka (foot), who is listed as questionable for Sunday's game at Chicago, is slated to return to action, Tom Pelissero of Netflix reports.

items.title: Amon-Ra St. Brown: In line to play Sunday
items.description:

items.title: Demarcus Robinson: Off IR, clear for Sunday
items.description:
Robinson (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, per Matt Maiocco of NBC Sports Bay Area, and the 49ers removed his questionable designation for Sunday's game versus the Raiders.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Pat Bryant: Activated from IR
items.description:
Bryant (ankle) was activated from injured reserve Saturday, but he remains questionable for Sunday's game in Carolina, Zac Stevens of TheDNVR.com reports.
